title: All API endpoints MUST validate input against an OpenAPI schema

specification.violation_message_template:
Endpoint '${endpoint.method} ${endpoint.path}' in ${file.path}:${file.line} does not validate input against an OpenAPI schema.

Action required:
1. Create or update the schema in ${schema_directory}/
2. Import the schema in your handler file
3. Wrap your handler with validateRequest(schema)

See: https://wiki.internal.example.com/security/api-standards

evidence.description: SQL injection via unvalidated API input (2025-11-03)
Internal security standard requiring input validation on all APIs
